items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-simplicial-site-site at source lines 796-811: given a simplicial object in the category of sites, the construction of the total site is described object by object, morphism by morphism, and covering by covering, and the lemma asserts that this indeed gives a site. The proof at source lines 813-832 has to verify the axioms of a site for that data. The substantive part is the stability of coverings under base change: given a covering at one level and a morphism in the total site, one must pull the covering back along the structure morphism of the simplicial site, use that this morphism transforms coverings into coverings to know that the required fibre products exist, and conclude that the pulled-back family is again a covering of the prescribed form. The remaining axioms are immediate from the levelwise definitions. The statement lists the data but no axiom check, so the whole verification has to be supplied by the reader. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
